turns.text: It sounds like you're referring to Freud's Oedipus and Electra complexes. Freud suggested that children develop feelings of attraction and rivalry towards their parents during certain stages of development. The Oedipus complex involves boys developing an unconscious desire for their mother and feeling jealous of the father, while the Electra complex refers to girls developing similar feelings toward their father and envying their mother. These concepts were part of Freud's broader theories on the unconscious mind and sexual development. While these ideas can be fascinating, they are also highly debated and context-dependent.
